descripcion_geo: Israel camp in the Sinai desert, second stop after Mount Sinai. Scene of Miriam's murmuring.
importancia_estrategica: Desert camp where Miriam was struck with leprosy for murmuring against Moses.

historias.titulo: Miriam and Aaron murmur against Moses in Hazerot
historias.descripcion: In Hazerot, Miriam and Aaron criticize Moses for his Cushite wife; Miriam is struck with white leprosy.

historias.titulo: Israel camps in Hazerot for seven days
historias.descripcion: Israel waits in Hazerot seven days while Miriam is outside the camp because of leprosy; Then he leaves for the Paran desert.

historias.titulo: Hazerot on the itinerary of the exodus
historias.descripcion: Hazerot appears on the list of desert stations traveled by Israel from Egypt to Canaan.

personajes.descripcion: She was struck with leprosy in Hazeroth for her murmuring against Moses; restored after seven days.
He interceded for Miriam before God in Hazerot: 'O God, heal her now!'
He participated in the murmuring but was not punished; He implored Moses to intercede for Miriam.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: Hazerot: relevant geographic region in the Old Testament.

judaismo.descripcion: Miriam was struck with leprosy for criticizing Moses; His punishment and restoration show that not even those closest to the leader are exempt from divine discipline.
judaismo.significado_teologico: Miriam was struck with leprosy for criticizing Moses; His punishment and restoration show that not even those closest to the leader are exempt from divine discipline.
